contractName: BTCSPVVerifier (FINAL — PoW + Chain Linkage verified on-chain)
version: FINAL — PoW + Chain Linkage verified on-chain
whatItVerifies: 1. PoW: double_sha256(header) computed on-chain, target from bits field, hash < target asserted
2. Chain linkage: prev_blockhash in header == stored chain_tip asserted
3. Merkle root extracted from header and stored for verify_anchor Merkle proof checks
4. Genesis tip (trusted checkpoint) set via owner-only set_genesis_tip — the single trust assumption
trustModel: Only the genesis/checkpoint block hash is trusted. Every subsequent block verified via PoW + chain linkage + Merkle proof.
